assertion.rationale: F1: data-api's middleware chain has a readOnlyGuard but no authentication layer in front of it, so external ingress means any caller can execute any exposed transaction (feed reads, table scans) without being limited to a permitted set. F13: zero workload RBAC exists in IaC — there is no principal-scoped restriction on which transactions or functions each workload identity may perform; the only grants that exist are subscription-scoped Owner (deployer) and Reader (verifier), an all-or-nothing shape with no per-function limitation for data-api, mcp-tools or cost-ingest.

recommendation: Set ingressExternal:false on data-api so its transactions are reachable only via the server-side proxy. Express the seven documented workload RBAC grants in IaC scoped to the specific transactions each principal needs (SQL contained-database user, Fabric Viewer, Log Analytics Reader, Security Reader, Cost Management Reader, Storage Blob Data Contributor/Reader) rather than the current all-or-nothing subscription grants.
